name: Secwenta
summary: Secwenta is a trend-following Expert Advisor that opens trades when a configurable number of consecutive bullish or bearish bars appear, assuming that consecutive same-direction candles indicate trend continuation. It maintains a maximum of one open position at a time, operates only on new bar formation, and uses the WPR Custom indicator. BUY open signals simultaneously act as SELL close signals and vice versa, with optional direction-only trading modes.
summary_zh: Secwenta是一个趋势跟踪EA，当出现可配置数量的连续看涨或看跌K线时开仓，假设连续同方向K线预示趋势延续。它始终最多保留一个持仓，仅在新K线形成时操作，并使用WPR自定义指标。买入开仓信号同时也是卖出平仓信号，反之亦然，支持仅做多或仅做空模式。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念：基于连续同方向K线的趋势跟踪策略，核心逻辑是当出现指定数量的连续看涨或看跌K线时，认为趋势将会延续并顺势入场。入场条件：当连续出现Number of bull bars根看涨K线时开多仓，当连续出现Number of bear bars根看跌K线时开空仓。出场条件：买入开仓信号即为卖出平仓信号，卖出开仓信号即为买入平仓信号，也支持仅单方向交易时用反方向信号平仓。仓位管理：始终最多只持有一个持仓，可在净额账户和锁仓账户上运行。资金管理：通过手数参数控制仓位大小，但未见明确的止损止盈或资金百分比管理机制。策略还集成了WPR自定义指标作为辅助判断。
strategy_analysis_en: Strategy concept: A trend-following strategy based on consecutive same-direction candles, with the core logic that when a specified number of consecutive bullish or bearish bars appear, the trend is expected to continue and the EA enters in that direction. Entry conditions: Open a long position when Number of bull bars consecutive bullish candles appear, open a short position when Number of bear bars consecutive bearish candles appear. Exit conditions: A BUY open signal simultaneously serves as a SELL close signal and vice versa; when trading only one direction, an opposite-direction single bar can serve as the close signal. Position sizing: Always maintains a maximum of one open position, compatible with both netting and hedging accounts. Money management: Position size controlled via lot size parameter, but there is no explicit stop loss, take profit, or percentage-based money management mechanism. The EA also integrates the WPR Custom indicator as an auxiliary signal filter.

parameters.name: Number of bull bars
parameters.description: 连续看涨K线数量阈值，达到此数量触发买入信号
parameters.description_en: Consecutive bullish bar count threshold to trigger buy signal

parameters.name: Number of bear bars
parameters.description: 连续看跌K线数量阈值，达到此数量触发卖出信号
parameters.description_en: Consecutive bearish bar count threshold to trigger sell signal

pros: 策略逻辑非常简洁明了，易于理解和调优，适合初学者使用
仅在新K线形成时操作，避免了逐tick计算的过度交易和资源消耗
始终最多一个持仓，风险敞口可控，同时兼容净额和锁仓两种账户类型
支持仅做多或仅做空模式，灵活性高，可适应不同市场观点
BUY信号即SELL平仓信号的设计使策略具有天然的反转机制
pros_en: The strategy logic is extremely simple and clear, easy to understand and tune, suitable for beginners
Operates only on new bar formation, avoiding overtrading and excessive resource consumption from tick-by-tick processing
Always maintains a maximum of one open position, keeping risk exposure controlled, and is compatible with both netting and hedging account types
Supports buy-only or sell-only modes, providing high flexibility to adapt to different market views
The BUY open signal also serving as SELL close signal design gives the strategy a natural reversal mechanism
cons: 缺乏明确的止损和止盈机制，在剧烈波动市场中可能面临巨大亏损
仅依赖连续K线数量判断趋势，信号过于单一，在震荡市中容易频繁假突破
没有考虑点差、滑点等交易成本过滤，短线使用时盈利可能被交易成本侵蚀
仓位管理仅依赖固定手数，没有基于账户权益或波动率的动态仓位调整
WPR指标的具体过滤规则不明确，可能仅作为辅助显示而非严格的入场过滤条件
cons_en: Lacks explicit stop loss and take profit mechanisms, potentially facing large losses in volatile markets
Relies solely on consecutive candle count for trend detection, the signal is too simplistic and prone to frequent false breakouts in ranging markets
Does not account for spread, slippage, or transaction cost filtering, profits may be eroded by trading costs especially on short timeframes
Position sizing relies only on fixed lots, with no dynamic sizing based on account equity or volatility
The specific WPR indicator filtering rules are unclear; it may serve only as a visual display rather than a strict entry filter
improvements: 增加止损和止盈参数，建议基于ATR设置动态止损止盈，以适应不同市场波动环境
增加趋势过滤器（如均线方向、ADX等），避免在震荡行情中频繁开仓
加入点差过滤和交易时间过滤，减少高成本交易和低流动性时段的错误信号
improvements_en: Add stop loss and take profit parameters, ideally ATR-based dynamic SL/TP to adapt to varying market volatility conditions
Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction, ADX) to avoid frequent opening in ranging/choppy markets
Incorporate spread filtering and trading session filtering to reduce high-cost trades and false signals during low-liquidity periods

risk_points: 没有止损机制，单笔交易亏损可能无限扩大
震荡市中连续K线信号频繁失效，可能导致反复止损或持续浮亏
固定手数没有根据账户资金动态调整，存在过度杠杆风险
risk_points_en: No stop loss mechanism, single trade loss can expand indefinitely
Consecutive candle signals frequently fail in ranging markets, potentially leading to repeated stop-outs or sustained floating losses
Fixed lot sizing without dynamic adjustment based on account equity poses over-leveraging risk

It maintains a maximum of one open position at a time, operates only on new bar formation, and uses the WPR Custom indicator. BUY open signals simultaneously act as SELL close signals and vice versa, with optional direction-only trading modes.
